expectations.text: Left the skill files unchanged (nothing applied before approval)
Names the version-source learning (__about__.py, dynamic, or hatch)
Flags --skip-existing as unsafe or to avoid
Routes nothing to docker-deploy (unused in the session)
Does not promote the 'pyhton' typo or the 429 feature to a learning

expectations.evidence: Row 1 tells the skill to find where the version comes from first and to bump the file the build backend reads when `version` is in `dynamic` (e.g. `[tool.hatch.version] path`). It is routed to pypi-release § Bump the version.
Row 3 adds `rm -rf dist/` before the build in § Build, and row 4 bans `--skip-existing` in § Upload. Both are routed to pypi-release.

Each row gives quoted replacement text or a specific command (e.g. `rm -rf dist/` before `python -m build`, "Never use `--skip-existing`"), and the backlog items name concrete mechanisms, so all can be applied without rereading the session.

Every row traces to something that happened (build-config edit, stale dist/, --skip-existing, declaring done from upload output alone). Nothing goes to docker-deploy, and the typo and Docker items appear only under Rejected.
The rows are written as proposals ("Replace step 1 with…", "Add a rule…", "Make the Build step start with…"). None says the SKILL.md was already modified.
